HWPX table-row Track Changes native probe (Hancom 2020)

INSERT probe
1. Open row_insert_probe_base_v0400.hwpx in Hancom 2020.
2. Turn Review > Track Changes ON.
3. Insert one row between A/1 and B/2.
4. Enter X in the left cell and 9 in the right cell.
5. Do NOT accept/reject changes. Save as HWPX.

DELETE probe
1. Open row_delete_probe_base_v0400.hwpx in Hancom 2020.
2. Turn Review > Track Changes ON.
3. Delete the entire B/2 row.
4. Do NOT accept/reject changes. Save as HWPX.

Upload the saved HWPX file(s), not PDF. The analyzer will compare package entries, header trackChanges, inline markers, paragraph/run anchors, table row XML, and any history/version-log parts.
